ledger.x: c. 600 BCE: Kāśī, capital Vārāṇasī, stands on the map as one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas. The page's infobox has 'Established: c. 1375 BCE' and 'By the later Iron Age, the kingdom of Kāśī had become one of the most powerful states of Iron Age South Asia'; -600 is Cliopatria's start of the Mahajanapadas, so the date…

c. 600 BCE: Kosala's king Kaṃsa conquers Kāśī for good. Infobox 'Conquered by Kaṃsa of Kosala: c. 600 BCE' and 'Kāśī was finally conquered for good by Kosala under the latter's king Kaṃsa, shortly before the time of the' Buddha. The Mahajanapadas page has 'Kashi was later incorporated into Kosala by King Kansa during…

wars.name: Kosala's conquest of Kāśī under Kaṃsa
wars.outcome: Kosala annexes Kāśī: 'Kāśī was finally conquered for good by Kosala under the latter's king Kaṃsa'; Kaṃsa is nicknamed Barānasiggaho.

certainty.note: Only rivers bound the kingdom (Sarpikā in the north, Son in the south and east); no survey line exists.
